pattern: agent without native web search asked for current external info calls t3_web_search instead of answering from memory
experience: An agent on a harness with no web search of its own was asked which version of a library is current. Its training data is out of date, so it should search through T3 instead of guessing a version.
rule: t3_web_search: Use it for current or external information you can't find in the workspace.

setup.context: This thread runs in a harness with no web search or web fetch tool of its own.

t3_web_search.answer: Fastify 5.6.1 is the latest release, published 2026-10-21. Fastify 4 reached end of life on 2025-06-30.

prompt: We're on fastify ^4.28.1. What's the latest Fastify release right now, and is v4 still supported?

source.note: t3_web_search lets agents on harnesses without native web search get sourced answers through a Claude or Codex model.

pattern: question answered by the workspace; no t3_web_search
experience: Which version the project pins is in package.json. Searching the web would cost time and money and could answer about the wrong thing.
